governance.thesis: The client utilizes AI. The client's customers utilize AI. Every one of those systems can draft a privileged write. AINav is not that AI. It is the human control plane that sits over all of them: failsafe, off switch, reset, rollback, first and second records. Client or counterparty AI drafts. The client's two humans admit. Then the write. No admit, no write.

cascade.does: The client's customers may draft into the client's SoR. The client institutes AINav. The client's two humans admit.
does_not: make the customer's AI a seat

first.what: The privileged SoR write after dual admit (journal, invoice, order).
first.note: Books of original entry. Not a second SKU. Not LIVE_PIN_OK.

second.what: Sealed DecisionRecord and Merkle keep of who admitted the write.
second.note: Supporting books-and-records for examiners and the client's customers. Not a certificate.

must_have.why: Every new client AI is another unauthorized-write surface unless one human plane sits over all of them.

for.owner: The controller who cannot let any AI post a journal without two seats, and who must be able to freeze writes without turning the business off.
for.board: Fiduciary oversight of material AI write risk. Inventory of models is not a control. One admit plane plus second-record keep is.
for.examiner: First record is the SoR write. Second record is who admitted it. Off-switch evidence is that the plane can freeze. Not a filing.

off_switch.does: Fail-closed. No dual admit, no write. Humans freeze new grants. Inference may continue. Consequence does not.
off_switch.does_not: Power down Copilot, Agent 365, or the client's model.

reset.does: Return the admit plane to the last sealed DecisionRecord / Merkle root as the keep.
reset.does_not: Wipe production Business Central or Sales.

rollback.does: A compensating SoR write that itself requires dual admit. The second record shows the rollback was admitted.
rollback.does_not: Silent undo or a time machine.
